salon.name: Meena's Beauty Parlour
salon.description: A premium beauty salon in the heart of Thanjavur, dedicated to making every woman look and feel her absolute best.
salon.address: Kalyani covering upstairs, bus stand, Southeast rampart, old, near Poorvika mobiles, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu 613001
salon.hours: Mon–Sat: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM | Sun: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM

about.story: Founded over a decade ago by Meena, our parlour has grown to become one of Thanjavur's most loved beauty destinations. We blend traditional beauty wisdom with modern techniques to deliver results that are truly transformative.
about.ownerMessage: Beauty is not just about looking good — it's about feeling confident, radiant, and most importantly, yourself. Every woman who walks through our doors deserves to leave feeling like the best version of herself.

services.name: Bridal Makeup
services.description: Complete bridal look with traditional & contemporary styles

services.name: Mehendi
services.description: Bridal & party mehendi with intricate designs

services.name: Manicure & Pedicure
services.description: Nail care, spa treatments & nail art

reviews.name: Priya S.
reviews.review: Meena's parlour is my go-to for all beauty needs! The bridal package was absolutely stunning. I've never felt more beautiful on my wedding day.

reviews.name: Kavitha R.
reviews.review: Excellent service and very professional staff. The facial combo left my skin glowing for weeks. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Anitha M.
reviews.review: Amazing place! The mehendi designs are so intricate and beautiful. Booking was easy and the staff is very warm.

reviews.name: Lakshmi T.
reviews.review: I've been coming here for 3 years and the quality never drops. Best parlour in Thanjavur, no question!

reviews.name: Deepa N.
reviews.review: The hair treatment was wonderful. They really listened to what I wanted and delivered perfectly. Will definitely return!
